parties: RC, Starting vessels of course bravo
procedural_matters: The race committee was represented by Sebastian Mayer, deputy race officer on race area Bravo.
NED 2931 was represented by Felix Mulder.
Alexander Bartelt, member of the race committee on the pin-end vessel, gave evidence.
Cas van Dongen, coach of NED 2931, attended the hearing as an observer.
The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: Race Q5 for Red fleet, the wind was 10-12 knots with small chops.
At the preparatory signal the race committee displayed the black flag.
NED 2931 was identified in the triangle formed by the ends of the starting line and the first mark during the last minute before the starting signal.
NED 2931 was scored BFD in race Q5.
conclusions: There was neither an improper action nor improper omission of the race committee. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
